methods.name: getReferrerDetails
methods.docs:
Retrieves the install referrer details from Google Play.
Note: This method only works on Android. On iOS/Web, it will reject with an error.

properties.name: referrerUrl
properties.docs: The referrer URL of the installed package.

properties.name: referrerClickTimestampSeconds
properties.docs: The timestamp in seconds when referrer click happened.

properties.name: appInstallTimestampSeconds
properties.docs: The timestamp in seconds when installation began.

properties.name: referrerClickTimestampServerSeconds
properties.docs: The timestamp in seconds when the user first opened the app after installation.

properties.name: appInstallTimestampServerSeconds
properties.docs: The timestamp in seconds when the app installation began from the server's perspective.

properties.name: installVersion
properties.docs: The app's version at the time when the app was first installed.

properties.name: googlePlayInstantParam
properties.docs: Whether the instant experience was launched.
